name: Nemurenu Yoru ni
source:
Yuichi Okamoto keeps seeing the same dream every night. It is about a girl pleasing herself in a bungalow. At school he sees his classmate Shinagawa Shinna who is the same girl that appears in his dreams.

The next day during the dream she opens up the curtains, approaches and says "hug me".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
冈本雄一每晚都会做同一个梦。这是关于一个女孩在平房里取悦自己的故事。在学校里，他见到了他梦中出现的同班同学品川新菜。

第二天，在梦中，她打开窗帘，走近并说“拥抱我”。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
